purpose: Truth-safety after S0-T1 measurement: the hook contract has no defensible stable entry clock for blockedSince, so treat that field as one that may never arrive. Absent standbyMs and an absent dead-time hero are the EXPECTED state, not a failure. The only hard forbid is inventing zero — unmeasurable ≠ 0ms, and a missing clock must never mint a hero that pretends the wait was measured.

s0t1.finding: no defensible stable entry clock for blockedSince
s0t1.consequence: do not require standbyMs or a dead-time hero to exist; pulse.blocked may still count

cases.name: blocking agents without blockedSince — duration absent, count still honest
cases.claim: A count is honest when a duration is not. pulse.blocked can still say how many are waiting. standbyMs must be absent or null — never 0 — and no dead-time hero may be invented from that absence.

cases.name: even a fabricated blockedSince must not force a hero — absence remains legal
cases.claim: S0-T1 closed the door on a required duration. A fixture must not treat a publishable standbyMs as the happy path this surface depends on. If blockedSince ever appears, inventing 0ms is still forbidden; requiring the hero is also forbidden.
